claude.rationale: gap_45=0 and gap_56=0 because Section 2 documents a whole-entity reverse triangular merger in which the natural-gas distribution service (T4), distribution operations (T5), and the workforce (T6) all transferred together with the surviving Piedmont entity as a going concern under state-commission oversight — no product-vs-process or process-vs-organization mismatch at closing. p4_pathway=0 and p5_pathway=0 because Section 4 explicitly states none documented at the product/process and process/organization interfaces, with the regulated service and operations transferring together and no integration-failure event located in the sourced filings.
